caseName: Louisville v. the Bank of Commerce
caseNameFull: City of Louisville v. Bank of Commerce
summary: Appeal from the .Circuit Court of the United States for the District of Kentucky.

opinions.author: Peckham
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Peckham.

In the above case the same question is involved that has .just been determined in No. 362, and there will be a like order reversing the judgment and remanding the case to the Circuit Court with directions to dismiss the bill.

Mr. Justice Harlan and Mr. Justice White dissented.
